trigger: The complete edge checker made zero false acceptances but left 14 actually optimal greedy paths unverified on the 26 public graphs.
diagnosis: Optimality and witness validity are separate: a bad potential vector does not establish that the submitted path is suboptimal.
repair: Replace only the greedy path-prefix potential proposal with potentials produced by the existing topological exact solver.
expected_result: All original greedy paths remain identical; optimal ones can now be certified, suboptimal ones cannot.
cost_obligation: Charge both producers' input validation/indexing, the original greedy work and prefix witness, plus the exact solver's work as witness construction. Compare with running the exact solver directly.
checks: Replay all 26 public graphs and add repaired-candidate checks on 27 complete three-node graphs with edge weights in {-2,0,3}.
exposure: Follow-up chosen after inspecting development results; no unseen-test claim.
stop_rule: Stop after coverage and soundness rechecks. Do not call witness repair algorithm improvement or a cheaper-solving result.
